BiblicalUsage: Battuchoth means security, safety, and Job says the tabernacles of robbers prosper and those who provoke God are secure.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the security of the wicked is the hardest thing in Job to bear, because it looks as though provoking God costs nothing.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
